'''Surro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She led a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] consisting of [[Danak]], [[Garault]], [[Landai]], and [[Onok]] that adopted a sixth line to the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]—"There is no contemplation, there is only duty."

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]] the team served as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] scouts on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] after [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] [[Cheketta]]'s defeat at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]]. After Danak failed to return from a scouting mission to the factory, Surro led the team to scout Imperial camps for his location, but they arrived too late and Danak was executed by Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bowenn]] right in front of them. Surro then led the team to follow a local Imperial sympathizer [[Ivo (Balmorran)|Ivo]], who turned Danak to the Empire in the first place. She questioned him and also persuaded Garault to simply erase his memory instead of killing him in vengeance.<ref name="Sixth Line Part One" />

[[File:Master_Surro_Possessed.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Master Surro's body is possessed by Vitiate.]]
The group shared a strong bond that night, and in [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="3.2 Date" /><ref name="A Presence on Ziost" /> when Surro was asked to lead a mission to [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] by [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] agent [[Theron Shan]], Garault, Landai, and Onok followed her without hesitation. Unfortunately, after arriving on the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface, the entire team fell under the control of the former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], who used them as his puppets, slaying Imperials and innocents alike. Theron Shan, [[Sith Intelligence]] Minister [[Lana Beniko]] and their ally [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]] uncovered that Vitiate's mind control over his subjects was broken by electrocution and arranged for Surro and other puppets to be shocked en masse in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[New Adasta]]. Vitiate claimed that Surro's body was his favorite so far and engaged Outlander in combat, but was defeated and Surro regained control of her body. After reawakening Surro told Lana and Theron that she still hears the Emperor's voice, and was taken away from Ziost by Shan and Beniko.<ref name="Dead Center">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|Dead Center|Ziost}}</ref>

Before [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="6.2 Date" /> she died from unknown reason and has appeared as a ghost or spirit when the Outlander and their allies have [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|defeated]] Vitiate for good.<ref name="Echoes" />

==Behind the scenes==
After Surro is defeated, the player has a choice of either [[Death/Legends|killing]] her, sending her to the Empire to be experimented on because of her possession by Vitiate, or sending her to Satele Shan. The first two options give the player dark side points, while the latter gives light side points.<ref name="Dead Center" />
